clips.title: The story
paras: Naga invaders and aquatic beasts crowd the Pool of Ask'ar, deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Its submerged halls hold night elven stonework and passages into the corrupted sanctuary.

Past the Drowned Sacellum, cold, murky water fills the Pool of Ask'ar beneath a vast cavern vault. Oversized snapping turtles and deep-sea crabs nest among natural caverns and ancient stonework, watched over by Ghamoo-ra, an enormous ancient chelonian. Naga have seized the temple and use this flooded threshold to guard the approaches leading deeper into the complex, toward Lady Sarevess and the Moonshrine Ruins.

The Pool of Ask'ar hides relics from the shrine's past before the Sundering, beyond its dangerous creatures and naga patrols. Submerged ledges and hidden alcoves along the cavern's edges hold lost artifacts, including the Lorgalis Manuscript sought by Gerrig Bonegrip, a dwarven scholar from Ironforge. Swim through the flooded southern passages to reach dry tunnels guarded by vile murlocs and Old God cultists. The pool remains a vital waterway through Blackfathom Deeps.
